text:
jamal: Quick Q — how do I pull up logs for a specific request_id or trace_id? I have x-request-id=abc123 and trace_id=1a2b3c. Prefer console flow but CLI is fine. :eyes:

maria: Console flow is easiest: Observability -> Logs -> set time range -> paste the request id into the search box (we index as `request_id` or sometimes `req_id`). If you only have trace_id, go Observability -> Traces -> search for the trace -> open it -> click 'Related logs' (shows linked log lines).

maria: CLI examples (rwctl is the standard tool; replace env and ids):
```bash
# find logs by request id (recent)
rwctl logs query --env=prod --since=6h --filter 'request_id="abc123"'

# fallback: grep raw pod logs for the id if structured indexing missed it
kubectl -n prod logs -l app=api --tail=500 | rg "abc123"

# trace -> related logs (quick lookup)
rwctl traces get 1a2b3c --env=prod --format json | jq -r '.spans[]? | .events[]?.attributes | select(.request_id) | .request_id'
```

jamal: Tried the rwctl logs query and it returned nothing, but the trace shows up in the Traces UI.

maria: Two things to check: 1) some services log the header as `x-request-id` instead of `request_id` (try both). 2) log-ingest sampling: if the trace was sampled but logs were dropped we won't see them in indexed logs — raw pod logs grep should still show lines if the pod still has them.

alex: If raw/grep also fails, include these when pinging eng-sre: trace_id, approximate timestamp, request_id header value, and one example span id. We can check the ingest pipeline and correlate OTLP->log mapping. Also note: prod raw log retention is 7d by default.

ben: fwiw we added a quick dashboard link in my notes that opens a trace then shows related logs button — ping me and I can share the URL to the view if it helps. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: If you want, run `rwctl support bundle --trace 1a2b3c --since 1h` and attach it to the ticket; it zips traces + metadata we need.

jamal: great, will try the kubectl grep and then send a bundle if still nothing. thanks everyone :pray:
